div.head: Leis Wl 3
div.ab: La custume en Merchenelahe est: Si aucuns est apelé de larrecin u de roberie, e il seit plevi a venir devant justise, e il s’en fuie dedenz sun plege, il averad terme un meis e un jur de querre le; e s’il le pot truver dedenz le terme, sil merra a la justise; e s’il nel pot truver, si jurra sei duzime main, que a l’hure qu’il le plevi, larrun nel sout, ne par lui s’en est fuid, ne aver nel pot.

Cost est la custume en Merchenelae: Se alquens est apeled de larecin u de roberie, e seit plevi de venir a justice, e il s’e[n] fuie dedenz son plege, si avera . . . de [un] meis e I jour de quer le; e si il le pot truver . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ., si jur[r]ad sei dudzime main, que a l’ure que il le plevi, laroun nel sot, ne per lui ne s’e[n]t est fui, ne aveir nel pot.

De plegiatis fugientibus. Si quis appellatus de latrocinio uel roberia plegiatur ad habendum ad iusticiam et interim fugerit, in Merchenelahe dabitur plegio respectus unius mensis et unius diei querendi fugitiuum; quem si infra terminum prescriptum inuenerit, iusticie offerat; si minus, iurabit XIIª manu, quod hora, qua eum plegiauit, nesciuit, quod latro esset, quod consilio aut ope sua non fugerit, et quod eum habere non potest ad iusticiam.

La custume en Merchenelahe est: si aucuns est apelé de larrecin u de roberie, e il seit plevi a venir devant justise e il s'en fuie dedenz sun plege, il averad terme un meis e un jur de querre le; e s'il le pot truver dedenz le terme, s'il merra a la justise; e s'il nel pot truver, si jurra sei duzime main que, a l'hure qu'il le plevi, larrun nel sout, ne par lui s'en est fuid, ne aver nel pot.

3. Das Gewohnheitsrecht im Mercier-Rechtsgebiet ist (folgendes I): Wenn jemand wegen Diebstahls oder Raubes verklagt ist und er wird unter Bürgschaft, dass er vor Gericht kommen werde, genommen und er entflieht innerhalb seiner Verbürgung, so soll [dies]er [Bürge] Frist (von IL) 1 Monat und 1 Tag erhalten, ihn zu suchen. Und wenn er ihn innerhalb der Frist finden kann, so soll er ihn zum Gericht führen; und wenn er ihn nicht finden kann, so soll er selbzwölfter Hand schwören, dass zur Zeit, da er ihn in Bürgschaft nahm, er ihn nicht als einen Dieb kannte, noch [jener] durch ihn entflohen ist, und er jenen nicht erlangen kann.

3. The customary law in the Mercian legal district is (the following I): if someone is accused of theft or robbery and he is taken under surety that he will come before the court, and he flees within his suretyship, then [th]is [surety] shall receive a term (of IL) 1 month and 1 day to seek him. And if he can find him within the term, he shall lead him to the court; and if he cannot find him, he shall swear with himself as twelfth hand that, at the time when he took him in surety, he did not know him as a thief, nor has [that man] fled through him, and he cannot get hold of that man.

It is the custom in the province of Mercia, that if anyone, who is accused of larceny or robbery and is under surety to appear before the Court, escapes in the meantime, then his surety shall have respite for a month and a day to seek him, and if he can find him within the set time, he shall bring him before the Court, and if he cannot find him he shall swear along with 11 compurgators that, at the time when he took him under surety, he did not know him to be a thief, and that he was not an accessory to his flight, and that he cannot find him.
